news.title: Resolution Adopted at the Extraordinary General Meeting of Genmab A/S Including Grant of Restricted Stock Units
news.summary: Genmab临时股东大会通过决议，包括授予限制性股票单位等事项。

news.title: Genmab and AbbVie Announce Epcoritamab in Combination with R-CHOP Demonstrates Statistically Significant Improvement in Progression-Free Survival in Patients with Newly Diagnosed Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
news.summary: III期EPCORE DLBCL-2研究显示，epcoritamab联合R-CHOP使初治弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤患者疾病进展或死亡风险降低51%。
